note: Brief 100, the why (Latch): the loud win (tools/game/pins/loud.seed3.json) and route G's quiet knockout with the Enforcer kept by the door (briefs/100/latch/route-g-radio.json, and -stopped where he takes the shift guard down as he radios). Each rise's and call's cause on the card that shows, the meter's list pinned open (why), the reporters on their way marked in the street, and two short clips. The Office front is played at yaw 210 (step 2).
